releaseNotes: 🔒 Production Cloud Firestore Security Hardening: Formally verified security rules with strict append-only reactions, host identity agreement, and default-deny protection.
🛡️ Android Platform Security: Firebase App Check with Play Integrity, scoped FileProvider paths, and encrypted session protection excluding auth tokens from backups.
🔑 Decoupled Release Signing: Environment and local property fallback for secure production APK signing without debug key exposure.
🎵 Three Premium Home Screen Widgets: Wide (4×2), Square (2×2), and Pill (4×1) widgets with full-bleed artwork and direct playback controls.
👥 Listen Together Real-Time Lounges: Multi-device music synchronization with drift compensation and live floating emoji reaction streams.
